title: Firing musicians and leading a band
summary: Musicians usually just stopped getting called; Tolliver has only chosen not to use players who should work elsewhere.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Would a musician like Andrew or others who were quote sort of leading, would they ever fire a musician or would they just sort of move on if they weren’t happy with what was being offered?
Well of course some musicians got verbally fired I would imagine. But generally you just never got called again.
Have you ever had to do that?
Well what do you mean? Have I ever had to fire a musician? I’ve had to not use a musician because I just felt that they needed to do what they were doing somewhere else.
Good way to put it. Yeah.

Yeah. And you know as I said I don’t people the band unless the musician is great on his instrument. So it had nothing to do with the fact that they weren’t great on their instrument. It had to do with what they were doing with that you know.
